source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_1.csv"

# Read CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# After join, columns from df0: '0' and from df1: '0' will conflict, so suffixes needed.

# The target schema is ['0_x': float, '0_y': float]
# So rename columns accordingly (already named by suffixes)
# Ensure columns are float type
joined = joined.astype({'0_x': float, '0_y': float})

# Save the result to the target path
